**(1st number + 1)³ × 2 = 2nd number**

2 : 54 → (2 + 1)³ × 2 = 3³ × 2 = 27 &a

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No onion is a lemon.

No lemon is a potato.

Conclusions:

I. No onion is a potato.

II. No potato is a lemon.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daf80f3494d820ee3549d7a5faae1208fe00d910d550226ff93d03d20cec9e9a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No onion is a potato → False (it is possible but not definite)

II. No potato is a lemon → True (as no lemon is a potato)

Hence, **only conclusion II follows.**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Amphibian : Frog :: Reptile : ?
questions.solution:
Given: Amphibian : Frog : : Reptile : ? 

The logic followed here is:

Frog is an Amphibian.

Similarly,

Lizard is a Reptile.

Hence, **lizard **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**Amphibian → a cold-blooded vertebrate animal of a class that comprises the frogs, toads, newts, salamanders, and caecilians.

Reptile → a vertebrate animal of a class that includes snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and tortoises. They are distinguished by having a dry scaly skin and typically laying soft-shelled eggs on land.

 
• **Cockroaches** are insects of the order Blattodea, which also includes termites.
 
• Kangaroos are marsupials. However, as marsupials are one of the three subgroups of mammals, kangaroos are also mammals, or** “pouched mammals”.**
 
• Mouse is a mammal in the animal kingdom. As a member of the order Rodentia, **it is a rodent.**

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some rings are calendars.

All rings are caps.

Conclusions:

I. All calendars are rings.

II. At least some calendars are caps.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fab27f1dc876a5ecb48dbf4221c3bfd9374d34994bc9bd4f1dd81cd3c80276cf.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All calendars are rings → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the diagram above)

II. At least some calendars are caps → True (as all rings are calendars and all rings are caps, so the part of the calendar which are rings are caps too) 

Hence, **only conclusion II follows. **

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 15
 12
 90
 
 

 16
 13
 104
 
 

 12
 18
 ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: Row wise, 

Row (1) → (15 ÷ 2) × 12 = 7.5 × 12 = 90

Row (2) → (16 ÷ 2) × 13 = 8 × 13 = 104

Similarly,

Row (3) → (12 ÷ 2) × 18 = 6 × 18 = 108

Hence, **108 **is the correct answer.
